lines.t:
A general term for everything on the <c:ffff00>{{field}}<c> during a
<c:ffff00>{{robattle}}<c> other than <c:ffff00>{{medabot|pl}}<c>.
Objects have <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c> and <c:ffff00>actions<c> like {{medabot|pl}}, as
well as unique effects. They can also be the <c:ffff00>{{target}}<c>
of <c:ffff00>attacks<c> and, like {{medabot|pl}}, are <c:ffff00>destroyed<c> when
their <c:ffff00>{{armor}}<c> reaches 0.
<c:ffff00>Traps<c> and <c:ffff00>Plants<c>, which are mostly placed with
actions of the <c:ffff00>Set-up skill<c>, are also classified as
objects and can be destroyed by attacks.
